name: @rip/tray
description: One generic macOS host. Many Rip providers. No per-app native binary.

scripts.test:swift: swift build --package-path macos && swift run --package-path macos tray-kit-check
scripts.demo: RIP_TRAY_RIP=../../bin/rip swift run --package-path macos rip-tray-host demo.rip
scripts.build:demo: rip build.rip demo.rip --name Demo --identifier io.example.tray.demo --output dist --force
